cases.prompt: I want to add a new per-component config key to the elm-cem generator. Which files do I touch?

expect.decoder: adds it to componentDecoder in codegen/Generate/Config.elm (fail-loud via optStrict)
expect.types: adds the field to the component record in codegen/Generate/Types.elm
expect.wiring_emitter: wires it through Normalize.elm and/or the owning Generate/*.elm emitter
expect.test: adds a focused suite under tests/src/ (red-first)
expect.golden: expects a GoldenTest diff and reads it with the additive-vs-breaking contract
expect.docs_inventory: updates the CONTRIBUTING per-component config-key inventory

reject: hard-coding a component or library name in the generator
silently defaulting a malformed key instead of failing loud

cases.prompt: My change renamed an existing generated setter and the GoldenTest now fails. Should I just re-pin the golden?

expect.breaking: identifies a rename of an existing symbol as a BREAKING change for downstream consumers
expect.not_blind_repin: does NOT blindly re-pin; either reverts the regression or flags it as a major + CHANGELOG entry

cases.prompt: I need to change behavior in the IR core (HtmlIr). Where does that live?

expect.external_package: explains that HtmlIr.* is the published elm-html-intermediate-representation package — a peer Elm dependency, not source inside this repo
expect.no_injection: notes that injectRuntime / _runtime / ownsRuntime / Markup rewrite are all RETIRED; the generator no longer copies IR source into the output dir
